J2-GAP-admin-credentials-empty-on-error.note: GET /api/admin/platform-credentials catches any platformOAuthCredential.findMany failure (not only a missing table) and returns 200 {credentials:[]}, so an outage reads as "no credentials stored".

J2-GAP-error-under-2xx.note: The failed or unconfigured read is reported in the body (error field) under HTTP 200, and dunning-state also asserts state:"current". Needs a 5xx/503 or available:false.

J2-GAP-integrations-all-false-on-error.note: GET /api/integrations catches the platformConnection read failure and returns the all-false emptyIntegrations default with 200, so a database outage reads as "nothing connected".

J2-GAP-profile-null-fallback.note: Profile reads catch the database error and return 200 with a null or blank profile ({profile:null}, null vault fields, empty bio with memberSince stamped from the clock).

J2-GAP-swallowed-list-reads.note: Routes that still import lib/platform/noop-client: the route or its service catches the data failure and returns 200 with empty lists and zero counts. P2 (retire the stub) owns these.

J2-GAP-zeroed-metrics-fallback.note: Dashboard and stats reads catch the database error and return 200 with every metric zeroed and lists empty (stats adds a fabricated "1.0x" engagement multiplier), so an outage renders as a real zero.
